ayahs.1: Qasam hai saf baandhne wale (farishton) ki.
ayahs.2: Phir poori tarah daantne walon ki.
ayahs.3: Phir Zikrullah ki tilawat karne walon ki.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan tum sab ka mabood ek hi hai.
ayahs.5: Aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki tamaam cheezon aur mashriqon ka Rabb wahi hai.
ayahs.6: Hum ne aasmaan-e-dunya ko sitaron ki zeenat se aaraasta kiya.
ayahs.7: Aur hifazat ki sarkash shaitaan se.
ayahs.8: Aalam-e-baala ke farishton (ki baaton) ko sunne ke liye woh kaan bhi nahin laga sakte, balke har taraf se woh maare jaate hain.
ayahs.9: Bhagaane ke liye aur un ke liye daimi azaab hai.
ayahs.10: Magar jo koi ek aadh baat uchak le bhaage to (fauran hi) us ke peechhe dehekta hua shola lag jaata hai.
ayahs.11: Un kaafiron se poochho to ke aaya un ka paida karna zyada dushwaar hai ya (un ka) jinhein hum ne (un ke ilawa) paida kiya? Hum ne (insanon) ko lais-daar mitti se paida kiya hai.
ayahs.12: Balke tu taajjub kar raha hai aur yeh maskhara-pan kar rahe hain.
ayahs.13: Aur jab unhein naseehat ki jaati hai yeh nahin maante.
ayahs.14: Aur jab kisi moajize ko dekhte hain to mazaaq udaate hain.
ayahs.15: Aur kehte hain ke yeh to bilkul khullam-khulla jaadu hi hai.
ayahs.16: Kya jab hum mar jaayenge aur khaak aur haddi ho jaayenge phir kya (sach-much) hum uthaaye jaayenge?
ayahs.17: Kya hum se pehle ke hamare baap-daada bhi?
ayahs.18: Aap jawab dijiye! Ke haan haan aur tum zaleel (bhi) hoge.
ayahs.19: Woh to sirf ek zor ki jhidki hai ke yakayak yeh dekhne lagenge.
ayahs.20: Aur kahenge ke haaye hamari kharabi yehi jaza (saza) ka din hai.
ayahs.21: Yehi faisle ka din hai jise tum jhutlaate rahe.
ayahs.22: Zaalimon ko aur un ke humrahiyon ko aur (jin) jin ki woh Allah ke ilawa parastish karte the.
ayahs.23: (Un sab ko) jama karke unhein dozakh ki raah dikha do.
ayahs.24: Aur unhein thahra lo, (is liye) ke un se (zaroori) sawaal kiye jaane wale hain.
ayahs.25: Tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke (is waqt) tum ek doosre ki madad nahin karte.
ayahs.26: Balke woh (sab ke sab) aaj farmabardar ban gaye.
ayahs.27: Woh ek doosre ki taraf mutawajjah ho kar sawaal-o-jawab karne lagenge.
ayahs.28: Kahenge ke tum to hamare paas hamari daayen taraf se aate the.
ayahs.29: Woh jawab denge ke nahin balke tum hi imaan wale na the.
ayahs.30: Aur kuchh hamara zor to tum par tha (hi) nahin. Balke tum (khud) sarkash log the.
ayahs.31: Ab to hum (sab) par hamare Rabb ki yeh baat saabit ho chuki ke hum (azaab) chakhne wale hain.
ayahs.32: Pas hum ne tumhein gumraah kiya hum to khud bhi gumraah hi the.
ayahs.33: So ab aaj ke din to (sab ke sab) azaab mein shareek hain.
ayahs.34: Hum gunahgaaron ke saath isi tarah kiya karte hain.
ayahs.35: Yeh woh (log) hain ke jab un se kaha jaata hai ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin to yeh sarkashi karte the.
ayahs.36: Aur kehte the ke kya hum apne maboodon ko ek deewane shayar ki baat par chhod dein?
ayahs.37: (Nahin nahin) balke (Nabi) to haq (sachcha deen) laaye hain aur sab Rasoolon ko sachcha jaante hain.
ayahs.38: Yaqeenan tum dardnaak azaab (ka maza) chakhne wale ho.
ayahs.39: Tumhein isi ka badla diya jaayega jo tum karte the.
ayahs.40: Magar Allah Taala ke khaalis barguzeeda bande.
ayahs.41: Un hi ke liye muqarrara rozi hai.
ayahs.42: (Har tarah ke) meway, aur woh ba-izzat-o-ikraam honge.
ayahs.44: Takhton par ek doosre ke saamne (baithe) honge.
ayahs.45: Jaari sharaab ke jaam ka un par daur chal raha hoga.
ayahs.46: Jo saaf shaffaaf aur peene mein lazeez hogi.
ayahs.47: Na is se dard-e-sar ho aur na is ke peene se behken.
ayahs.48: Aur un ke paas neechi nazron, badi badi aankhon wali (hooren) hongi.
ayahs.50: (Jannati) ek doosre ki taraf rukh karke poochhenge.
ayahs.51: Un mein se ek kehne wala kahega ke mera ek saathi tha.
ayahs.52: Jo (mujh se) kaha karta tha ke kya tu (qayamat ke aane ka) yaqeen karne walon mein se hai?
ayahs.53: Kya jabke hum mar kar mitti aur haddi ho jaayenge kya is waqt hum jaza diye jaane wale hain?
ayahs.54: Kahega tum chaahte ho ke jhaank kar dekh lo?
ayahs.55: Jhaankte hi use beechon beech jahannam mein (jalta hua) dekhega.
ayahs.56: Kahega wallah! Qareeb tha ke tu mujhe (bhi) barbaad kar de.
ayahs.57: Agar mere Rabb ka ehsaan na hota to main bhi dozakh mein haazir kiye jaane walon mein hota.
ayahs.58: Kya (yeh saheeh hai) ke hum marne wale hi nahin?
ayahs.59: Bajuz pehli ek maut ke, aur na hum azaab kiye jaane wale hain.
ayahs.60: Phir to (zaahir baat hai ke) yeh badi kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.61: Aisi (kaamyaabi) ke liye amal karne walon ko amal karna chaahiye.
ayahs.62: Kya yeh mehmani achchhi hai ya seendh (Zaqqum) ka darakht?
ayahs.63: Jise hum ne zaalimon ke liye sakht aazmaish bana rakha hai.
ayahs.64: Be-shak woh darakht jahannam ki jad mein se nikalta hai.
ayahs.65: Jis ke khoshay shaitanon ke saron jaise hote hain.
ayahs.66: (Jahannami) isi darakht se khaayenge aur isi se pet bharenge.
ayahs.67: Phir is par garam jalte jalte paani ki milaoni hogi.
ayahs.68: Phir un sab ka lautna jahannam ki (aag ke dher ki) taraf hoga.
ayahs.69: Yaqeen maano! Ke unhon ne apne baap-daada ko behka hua paaya.
ayahs.70: Aur yeh un hi ke nishan-e-qadam par daudte rahe.
ayahs.71: Un se pehle bhi bahut se agle behak chuke hain.
ayahs.72: Jin mein hum ne daraane wale (Rasool) bheje the.
ayahs.73: Ab to dekh le ke jinhein dhamkaaya gaya tha un ka anjaam kaisa kuchh hua.
ayahs.74: Siwaaye Allah ke barguzeeda bandon ke.
ayahs.75: Aur hamein Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne pukaara to (dekh lo) hum kaise achchhe dua qubool karne wale hain.
ayahs.76: Hum ne use aur us ke ghar walon ko is zabardast museebat se bacha liya.
ayahs.77: Aur us ki aulaad ko hum ne baaqi rehne wali bana di.
ayahs.78: Aur hum ne us ka (zikr-e-khair) pichhlon mein baaqi rakha.
ayahs.79: Nooh (alaihis salaam) par tamaam jahanon mein salaam ho.
ayahs.80: Hum neki karne walon ko isi tarah badla dete hain.
ayahs.81: Woh hamare imaan wale bandon mein se tha.
ayahs.82: Phir hum ne doosron ko dubo diya.
ayahs.83: Aur us (Nooh alaihis salaam ki) taabedaari karne walon mein se (hi) Ibraheem (alaihis salaam bhi) the.
ayahs.84: Jabke apne Rabb ke paas be-aib dil laaye.
ayahs.85: Unhon ne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha ke tum kya pooj rahe ho?
ayahs.86: Kya tum Allah ke siwa ghadhe hue mabood chaahte ho?
ayahs.87: To yeh (batlaao ke) tum ne Rabb-ul-Aalameen ko kya samajh rakha hai?
ayahs.88: Ab Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ne ek nigaah sitaron ki taraf uthaayi.
ayahs.89: Aur kaha main to beemar hoon.
ayahs.90: Is par woh sab us se munh mode hue waapas chale gaye.
ayahs.91: Aap (chup chupaate) un ke maboodon ke paas gaye aur farmaane lage tum khaate kyun nahin?
ayahs.92: Tumhein kya ho gaya ke baat tak nahin karte ho.
ayahs.93: Phir to (poori quwwat ke saath) daayen haath se unhein maarne par pil pade.
ayahs.94: Woh (but-parast) daude bhaage aap ki taraf mutawajjah hue.
ayahs.95: To aap ne farmaaya tum unhein poojte ho jinhein (khud) tum taraashte ho.
ayahs.96: Halaan-ke tumhein aur tumhari banaayi hui cheezon ko Allah hi ne paida kiya hai.
ayahs.97: Woh kehne lage is ke liye ek makaan banaao aur is (dehekti hui) aag mein ise daal do.
ayahs.98: Unhon ne to is (Ibraheem alaihis salaam) ke saath makr karna chaaha lekin hum ne un hi ko neecha kar diya.
ayahs.99: Aur is (Ibraheem alaihis salaam) ne kaha main to hijrat karke apne Parwardigaar ki taraf jaane wala hoon. Woh zaroor meri rehnumaai karega.
ayahs.100: Ae mere Rabb! Mujhe nek-bakht aulaad ata farma.
ayahs.101: To hum ne use ek burdbaar bachche ki basharat di.
ayahs.102: Phir jab woh (bachcha) itni umr ko pahuncha ke us ke saath chale phire, to is (Ibraheem alaihis salaam) ne kaha mere pyaare bachche! Main khwaab mein apne aap ko tujhe zabh karte hue dekh raha hoon. Ab tu bata ke teri kya raaye hai? Bete ne jawab diya ke Abba! Jo hukm hua hai ise baja laaiye inshaAllah aap mujhe sabr karne walon mein se paayenge.
ayahs.103: Gharaz jab dono mutee ho gaye aur us ne (baap ne) us ko (bete ko) peshani ke bal gira diya.
ayahs.104: To hum ne aawaaz di ke ae Ibraheem!
ayahs.105: Yaqeenan tu ne apne khwaab ko sachcha kar dikhaaya, be-shak hum neki karne walon ko isi tarah jaza dete hain.
ayahs.107: Aur hum ne ek bada zabeeha us ke fidye mein de diya.
ayahs.108: Aur hum ne un ka zikr-e-khair pichhlon mein baaqi rakha.
ayahs.110: Hum nekokaaron ko isi tarah badla dete hain.
ayahs.111: Be-shak woh hamare imaan-daar bandon mein se tha.
ayahs.112: Aur hum ne us ko Ishaaq (alaihis salaam) Nabi ki basharat di jo saalih logon mein se hoga.
ayahs.113: Aur hum ne Ibraheem-o-Ishaaq (alaihis salaam) par barkaten naazil farmaayen, aur un dono ki aulaad mein baaz to nek-bakht hain aur baaz apne nafs par sareeh zulm karne wale hain.
ayahs.114: Yaqeenan hum ne Moosa aur Haaroon (alaihis salaam) par bada ehsaan kiya.
ayahs.115: Aur unhein aur un ki qaum ko bahut bade dukh-dard se najat de di.
ayahs.116: Aur un ki madad ki to wahi ghaalib rahe.
ayahs.117: Aur hum ne unhein (waazeh aur) roshan kitaab di.
ayahs.118: Aur unhein seedhe raaste par qaayim rakha.
ayahs.119: Aur hum ne un dono ke liye peechhe aane walon mein yeh baat baaqi rakhi.
ayahs.120: Ke Moosa aur Haaroon (alaihimas-salaam) par salaam ho.
ayahs.121: Be-shak hum nek logon ko isi tarah badle diya karte hain.
ayahs.122: Yaqeenan yeh dono hamare momin bandon mein se the.
ayahs.123: Be-shak Ilyaas (alaihis salaam) bhi paighambaron mein se the.
ayahs.124: Jabke unhon ne apni qaum se farmaaya ke tum Allah se darte nahin ho?
ayahs.125: Kya tum Baal (naami but) ko pukaarte ho? Aur sab se behtar Khaliq ko chhod dete ho?
ayahs.126: Allah jo tumhara aur tumhare agle tamaam baap-daadon ka Rabb hai.
ayahs.127: Lekin qaum ne unhein jhutlaaya, pas woh zaroor (azaab mein) haazir rakhe jaayenge.
ayahs.128: Siwaaye Allah Taala ke mukhlis bandon ke.
ayahs.129: Hum ne (Ilyaas alaihis salaam) ka zikr-e-khair pichhlon mein bhi baaqi rakha.
ayahs.131: Hum neki karne walon ko isi tarah badla dete hain.
ayahs.132: Be-shak woh hamare imaan-daar bandon mein se the.
ayahs.133: Be-shak Loot (alaihis salaam bhi) paighambaron mein se the.
ayahs.134: Hum ne unhein aur un ke ghar walon ko sab ko najat di.
ayahs.135: Bajuz is budhiya ke jo peechhe reh jaane walon mein se reh gayi.
ayahs.136: Phir hum ne auron ko halaak kar diya.
ayahs.137: Aur tum to subah hone par un ki bastiyon ke paas se guzarte ho.
ayahs.138: Aur raat ko bhi, kya phir bhi nahin samajhte?
ayahs.139: Aur bila-shubha Younus (alaihis salaam) Nabiyon mein se the.
ayahs.140: Jab bhaag kar pahunche bhari kashti par.
ayahs.141: Phir qura-andaazi hui to yeh maghloob ho gaye.
ayahs.142: To phir unhein machhli ne nigal liya aur woh khud apne aap ko malaamat karne lag gaye.
ayahs.143: Pas agar yeh paaki bayaan karne walon mein se na hote.
ayahs.144: To logon ke uthaaye jaane ke din tak us ke pet mein hi rehte.
ayahs.145: Pas unhein hum ne chatiyal maidan mein daal diya aur woh is waqt beemar the.
ayahs.146: Aur un par saaya karne wala ek bel-daar darakht hum ne uga diya.
ayahs.147: Aur hum ne unhein ek laakh balke aur zyada aadmiyon ki taraf bheja.
ayahs.148: Pas woh imaan laaye, aur hum ne unhein ek zamana tak aish-o-ishrat di.
ayahs.149: Un se daryaft kijiye! Ke kya aap ke Rabb ki to betiyan hain aur un ke bete hain?
ayahs.150: Ya yeh is waqt maujood the jabke hum ne farishton ko moannas paida kiya.
ayahs.151: Aagaah raho! Ke yeh log sirf apni iftira-pardazi se keh rahe hain.
ayahs.152: Ke Allah Taala ki aulaad hai. Yaqeenan yeh mehez jhoothe hain.
ayahs.153: Kya Allah Taala ne apne liye betiyon ko beton par tarjeeh di.
ayahs.154: Tumhein kya ho gaya hai kaise hukm lagaate phirte ho?
ayahs.155: Kya tum is qadar bhi nahin samajhte?
ayahs.156: Ya tumhare paas is ki koi saaf daleel hai.
ayahs.157: To jaao agar sachche ho to apni hi kitaab le aao.
ayahs.158: Aur un logon ne to Allah ke aur jinnat ke darmiyaan bhi qaraabat-daari thahraayi hai, aur halaan-ke khud jinnat ko maloom hai ke woh (is aqeede ke log azaab ke saamne) pesh kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.159: Jo kuchh yeh (Allah ke baare mein) bayaan kar rahe hain is se Allah Taala bilkul paak hai.
ayahs.160: Siwaaye! Allah ke mukhlis bandon ke.
ayahs.161: Yaqeen maano ke tum sab aur tumhare maaboodon (baatil).
ayahs.162: Kisi ek ko bhi behka nahin sakte.
ayahs.163: Bajuz is ke jo jahannami hi hai.
ayahs.164: (Farishton ka qaul hai ke) hum mein se to har ek ki jagah muqarrar hai.
ayahs.165: Aur hum to (bandagi-e-Ilahi mein) saf-basta khade hain.
ayahs.166: Aur us ki tasbeeh bayaan kar rahe hain.
ayahs.168: Ke agar hamare saamne agle logon ka zikr hota.
ayahs.169: To hum bhi Allah ke cheeda bande ban jaate.
ayahs.170: Lekin phir is Quran ke saath kufr kar gaye, pas ab anqareeb jaan lenge.
ayahs.171: Aur albatta hamara waada pehle hi apne Rasoolon ke liye saadir ho chuka hai.
ayahs.172: Ke yaqeenan woh hi madad kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.173: Aur hamara hi lashkar ghaalib (aur bartar) rahega.
ayahs.174: Ab aap kuchh dinon tak un se munh pher lijiye.
ayahs.175: Aur unhein dekhte rahiye, aur yeh bhi aage chal kar dekh lenge.
ayahs.176: Kya yeh hamare azaab ki jaldi macha rahe hain?
ayahs.177: Suno! Jab hamara azaab un ke maidan mein utar aayega is waqt un ki jin ko mutanabbah kar diya gaya tha badi buri subah hogi.
ayahs.178: Aap kuchh waqt tak un ka khayaal chhod dijiye.
ayahs.179: Aur dekhte rahiye yeh bhi abhi abhi dekh lenge.
ayahs.180: Paak hai aap ka Rabb jo bahut badi izzat wala hai har us cheez se (jo mushrik) bayaan karte hain.
ayahs.182: Aur sab tarah ki taareef Allah ke liye hai jo saare jahaan ka Rabb hai.
